title: F4: a builder may rename a test and edit test comments and docstrings
why: Owner 15:50 CST Nov 18, word for word to the consultant: 'One question is still open: may builders rename tests and edit test comments (F4)? yes they can'.
note: Ruling for F4, narrows item 437 a: a builder may rename a test and edit test comments and docstrings when the parsed test bodies and the test count are unchanged. Home: decision builders-cannot-edit-tests (the consultant lands it). Prior-work search first.
